weekLabel: Week of Sep 6 to Sep 13 · refreshed Sunday Sep 6. Big weekend is Fri 11 to Sun 13. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.when: Fri Sep 11 12-9pm, Sat Sep 12 10am-9pm, Sun Sep 13 9am-6pm
events.name: Hampton Beach Seafood Festival (37th annual)
events.meta: $15 for all three days, kids 12 and under free · Hampton Beach, NH · Sixty-plus restaurants on the sand, three stages of live music, fireworks, and the ocean right there. Best single fit of the year for this family: seafood, ocean, live music, and it works for a 4-year-old and a 14-year-old at once. Also the most crowded Seacoast day of the year, so park in the state lots south of the strip or take the shuttle and be there before 11am Saturday. source

events.name: Boston Arts Festival (24th year)
events.meta: Free · Christopher Columbus Waterfront Park, Boston · Fifty-plus local artists on the harbor, live music, dance performances, workshops. Blankets and picnics encouraged. Walk to the North End after. Take the T to Aquarium; harbor parking on a festival Saturday is a bad plan. source

events.when: Fri Sep 11 6-11pm, Sat Sep 12 1-11pm, Sun Sep 13 1-10pm
events.name: 101st Feast of Saints Cosmas and Damian
events.meta: Free · 17 Porter St, East Cambridge · Century-old Italian street feast: carnival rides and games, Italian food stands, candlelight procession Friday, Taylor Dayne headlining Saturday night, Grand Procession Sunday. The rides make this the easiest one for Isabella. source

events.name: 32nd Cambridge Carnival International
events.meta: Free · University Park Commons, Cambridge · Costumes, steel pan, soca and dance through Cambridgeport, plus food and craft vendors. Around 100,000 people. One of the best free days of the year for KK. Red Line to Central, do not drive. source

events.name: Gilman Square Arts & Music Festival
events.meta: Free · Edward L. Leathers Community Park, Somerville · Live music, artists, crafters, food vendors, family activities. Walnut Street closes from Pearl to Medford. Closest thing on the list and the lowest-effort yes of the weekend. source

events.name: Revere Beach Art Festival
events.meta: Free · Markey Memorial Bridge, Revere Beach · Local artists, live music and a live art competition on the oldest public beach in the country. Short, oceanside, easy to pair with a walk on the sand. source

events.name: Boston College vs Rutgers (Red Bandanna Game)
events.meta: Ticketed · Alumni Stadium, 2599 Beacon St, Chestnut Hill · BC's home opener on the 25th anniversary of 9/11, honoring Welles Crowther. Night game, real atmosphere, best value college football ticket near Boston. The Dave-and-Alex play, and tickets will move. source

events.name: Revolution vs Orlando City
events.meta: Ticketed, parking free · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · The only Revs home match in September. Cheaper and easier than the NFL, and Patriot Place handles dinner before kickoff. source

events.name: 7th Salem Food Truck & Craft Beverage Festival
events.meta: Ticketed · Salem Common, N Washington Sq, Salem · Forty-plus food trucks, local and regional craft beer, artisan market, live music, lawn games. Salem in late September gets busy fast, so buy ahead and go early. source

events.name: Patriots home opener vs Steelers
events.meta: Ticketed · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · First home game of the season. If this is the year to take Alex to a Patriots game, buy now; home openers do not get cheaper. source

events.name: Oktoberfest at Wright-Locke Farm
events.meta: Free admission; beer from Arlington Brewing Company and food from Apritivo for purchase · 82 Ridge St, Winchester · Live music from The Gruvmeiners, Highs in the Low, Kier Byrnes & The Kettle Burners and Ryan Goes Hollywood, on the patio and lawn behind the All Seasons Barn. Garden tour and kids' activities 2-4pm. Free, in town, live music, real beer, real food. source

events.name: Topsfield Fair
events.meta: Ticketed · 207 Boston St, Topsfield · America's oldest county fair: giant pumpkins, livestock, midway rides, fried dough and grandstand concerts. Half a million people over eleven days. Buy grandstand tickets early if a name act matters. source
